paragraphs: The X5 M50d was introduced in 2013 as part of the F15-generation X5 range, representing the flagship diesel variant of the lineup. It uses BMW's N57 Tri-Turbo engine — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with three turbochargers arranged in a sequential layout, producing 381hp and 740Nm of torque. This engine was only offered for a single generation before being discontinued in 2018. The X5 M50d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
